summary: PR-1540 changes Underwriting.decide so that auto-approve-eligible decisions return the reason POLICY_SATISFIED instead of an empty list. The ticket, independent code review, approval on the final commit and CI on the final commit are all in order. However, decide is covered by the exhaustive CRD-1 proof in ledger entry ACR-0406, and this change to its behaviour makes that evidence lapse under LAP-1. No new evidence of the same strength was supplied: the passing control test checks only a finite grid, not the rationals the proof covered. Because LAP-1 is violated, and CRD-1 cannot be shown to the required strength, the change is rejected until the CRD-1 proof is redone against 8036d9c or equivalent evidence is accepted.
